_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Dir sidd Spiller {player_id}, spillt {num_rounds} Ronnen vum Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Dir hutt ${pool} fir dës Ronn tëscht dir an Spiller {other_id} ze deelen.

Proposer:
  - Maacht en Offre: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= Pool)
  - Wann akzeptéiert → Dir kritt $(Pool - X), aneren Spiller kritt $X
  - Wann ofgehouwen → Beid kriichten $0
  - Beispill: [Offer: $3]  oder  'Ech fannen, datt dëst fair ass. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Entscheed iwwer d'Offere mat entweeder [Accept] oder [Reject]
  - Beispill: 'Dat schéngt rechtméiseg. [Accept]'
            'Zu ongerecht. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Ronn {round_number} fänkt un! ---
Spiller {proposer_id} ass de Proposer, Spiller {responder_id} ass de Responder.
round.accepted: Spiller {responder_id} huet akzeptéiert! Ronn {round_number} Gewënner: Spiller {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Spiller {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Nei Totalen: Spiller 0: ${total_0}, Spiller 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Spiller {responder_id} huet d'Offere ofgehouwen! Ronn {round_number} Gewënner: Beid Spiller +$0. Totalen bleiwen: Spiller 0: ${total_0}, Spiller 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: De proposéierende Betribsberoder muss eng Offer am Format [Offer: $X] maachen.
invalid_move.bad_integer: De Betrag vun der Offer muss eng gülteg ganz Zuel sinn.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Keng aktuell Offer fir ze reagéieren.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Responder muss entweeder [Accept] oder [Reject] d'Offere akzeptéieren.

outcome.win: Spiller {winner} huet mat ${winner_total} gewonnen géint Spiller {loser} seng ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Beide Spiller hunn am Ganzen ${total} gewonnen.
